title: MTBE blending windows for an Iraqi catalytic reformate as summer gasoline: data, open-source models and Aspen HYSYS cases
description: Version 2.1: one fitted surrogate composition is now used for both the vapour-pressure and the distillation models; the reflux-ratio bound of the surrogate fit is widened from 20 to 100; the calibration and blending data were checked against the original papers; figures 3 and 4 are renumbered (fig3_validation, fig4_windows). Version 2.0 replaced the manual HYSYS workflow of version 1.0 with an open-source Python workflow: surrogate fitting to the measured D86 curve, RVP and density; MTBE vapour pressure with NRTL parameters fitted to binary VLE data; a D86 batch-distillation model with reflux calibrated on measured MTBE blends; Monte Carlo octane bounds; MTBE blending windows; figures and tables. The version 1.0 HYSYS cases and results are kept in cases/hysys and data/raw.
